subject: Contract redline check-in + vendor portal field gaps (FinWell)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Garcia <lisa.garcia@finwell.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Portal registration next steps — MSA redline + PO field gaps

Hi Lisa / Tom — thanks again for the sync this morning. I pulled together the two items we need to align on before we can finish your vendor activation in Ariba: the legal redline to the MSA and the portal field mapping for PO acknowledgement.

Quick summary / asks: 
- We attached our current redline (FinWell_MSA_redline_v3.docx). Can your legal team confirm whether the proposed liability language in §7.2 is acceptable to FinWell?
- Procurement: FinWell's portal does not currently surface 'Bill-to GL Code' and 'Tax Jurisdiction' on the PO payload. Our ops team has flagged these as required for downstream settlement. Please confirm if FinWell can add those fields or whether Redwood should map them to 'customAttributes'.
- SLA: we need a PO-ack window (24h automated ack preferred) or an escalation path if ack not received in 72h.

Next steps I propose: 
1) FinWell legal to review the attached redline by EOD Friday (11/27).
2) Procurement owners to confirm whether portal can add GL Code and Tax Jurisdiction fields, or provide a stable alternate field name we can map to.
3) If legal approves edits, we proceed to a short DocuSign-ready order form and schedule a final ops handoff.

I'm looping Marissa (legal ops) and Karthik (integration lead) to help track the two parallel threads.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Manager, Partner Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachment: FinWell_MSA_redline_v3.docx (redline, track changes)
Attachment: portal_field_mapping_finwell.xlsx

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finwell.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Garcia <lisa.garcia@finwell.com>, procurement@finwell.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Portal registration next steps — MSA redline + PO field gaps

Evelyn — appreciate the clear list. Quick updates from our side: 

- Legal: Lisa will coordinate internal review, target EOD 11/27 but may need until Monday 11/30 for signoff if there are any new counterpoints.
- Portal team: we can expose a customAttributes blob for GL Code and Tax data; adding first-class fields will take ~3 sprints. For now we can map 'customAttributes.GL' and 'customAttributes.TaxJurisdiction' in the PO export. Can you confirm Redwood will accept those keys?
- Acknowledgement: our platform can emit a 24h ACK for orders that reach 'Accepted' state. We will confirm SLA language once legal checks the MSA.

I'll ask procurement@finwell.com to confirm the mapping names and provide a short sample JSON payload.

—Tom
Tom Reynolds
Director, Strategic Sourcing | FinWell Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finwell.com>, Lisa Garcia <lisa.garcia@finwell.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Portal registration next steps — MSA redline + PO field gaps

Tom / Lisa — thanks. I pulled the redline and left two focused comments that affect the PO/ops flow so legal can prioritize: 

1) §3.1 (Order Flow) — we added a sentence to state that Redwood or its payment processor may transform non-standard PO fields into canonical attributes; that allows temporary mapping while you expose first-class fields. If FinWell cannot accept transformation language, ops will need a deterministic mapping table in the attached spreadsheet.

2) §9.4 (Audit Logs) — request that FinWell confirm a 12-month retention minimum for PO acceptance and invoice receipts. Our accounting needs that window for reconciliation.

If Lisa can confirm whether FinWell will accept the transformation clause, we can avoid pushing a full MSA amendment.

I attached a short 'field-mapping' worksheet (portal_field_mapping_finwell.xlsx) — column A shows Redwood canonical keys; column B is where FinWell should provide their mapping or confirm 'will add field'.

Marissa Cole
Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachment: portal_field_mapping_finwell.xlsx

From: procurement@finwell.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Lisa Garcia <lisa.garcia@finwell.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Portal registration next steps — MSA redline + PO field gaps

Hi Marissa / Karthik — attaching a sample PO export and the current portal schema. We plan to map as follows (sample):
- Redwood canonical: bill_to.gl_code => customAttributes.GL (string)
- Redwood canonical: tax.jurisdiction => customAttributes.TaxJurisdiction (string)
- ack.window => the platform emits 'ackTimestamp' when state transitions to Accepted; we'll emit within 24 hours for valid orders.

Attachment: finwell_sample_po_payload.json (stub)

Note: our schema does not include an explicit 'invoiceDueDays' field — we will default to payment terms in the order form. If Redwood needs invoice-due metadata we can add it to customAttributes but need engineering approval (2-week turnaround).

—Procurement Team, FinWell

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finwell.com>, Lisa Garcia <lisa.garcia@finwell.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Portal registration next steps — MSA redline + PO field gaps

Team — quick engineering check-in after reviewing the sample payload: mapping to customAttributes.GL and customAttributes.TaxJurisdiction works for our ingest pipeline. A couple of operational notes before we close: 

- Please ensure 'customAttributes.GL' is present on all POs (empty string is acceptable but key must exist) so our canonicalizer doesn't drop the field.
- Where FinWell cannot provide invoiceDueDays as a discrete field, add 'invoiceDueDays' to customAttributes with agreed default (30). We'll surface that to accounting.
- Marissa: if legal signs off on the transformation sentence in §3.1 we can avoid a sprint change; otherwise we will need a short amendment and that will push activation ~2 weeks.

If everyone confirms the three bullets, I'll schedule the ops handoff and create the activation playbook. Proposed handoff window: Thu 12/2 at 10:00 AM PT.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Integration Lead | Redwood Inference
